import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class SafeHash {
        static long splitmix64(long x) {
            x += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15L;
            x = (x ^ (x >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9L;
            x = (x ^ (x >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebL;
            return x ^ (x >> 31);
        }

        long operator()(long x) {
            static long FIXED_RANDOM = splitmix64(System.nanoTime() * (System.identityHashCode(new Object()) | 1));
            return splitmix64(x ^ FIXED_RANDOM);
        }
    }

    static class ModInt {
        int val;

        ModInt(long v) {
            if (v < 0)
                v = v % 1000000007 + 1000000007;

            if (v >= 1000000007)
                v %= 1000000007;

            val = (int) v;
        }

        static int modInv(int a) {
            int g = 1000000007, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;

            while (r != 0) {
                int q = g / r;
                g %= r;
                int temp = g;
                g = r;
                r = temp;
                x -= q * y;
                int temp2 = x;
                x = y;
                y = temp2;
            }

            return x < 0 ? x + 1000000007 : x;
        }

        ModInt plus(ModInt other) {
            val += other.val;
            if (val >= 1000000007)
                val -= 1000000007;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt minus(ModInt other) {
            val -= other.val;
            if (val < 0)
                val += 1000000007;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt times(ModInt other) {
            val = (int) (fastMod((long) val * other.val));
            return this;
        }

        ModInt div(ModInt other) {
            return times(other.inv());
        }

        static long fastMod(long x, int m) {
            return x % m;
        }

        ModInt inv() {
            return new ModInt(modInv(val));
        }

        ModInt pow(long p) {
            ModInt a = this, result = new ModInt(1);

            while (p > 0) {
                if (p % 2 == 1)
                    result = result.times(a);

                a = a.times(a);
                p >>= 1;
            }

            return result;
        }
    }

    static class FastScanner {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;

        FastScanner() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreElements()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        FastScanner scanner = new FastScanner();
        int N = scanner.nextInt();

        ModInt[][] probability = new ModInt[N][N];

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = scanner.nextInt();
                probability[i][j] = new ModInt(p) / new ModInt(100);
            }

        List<List<Integer>> masksWithCount = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++)
            masksWithCount.add(new ArrayList<>());

        int[] lookup = new int[1 << N];
        Arrays.fill(lookup, -1);

        for (int mask = 0; mask < 1 << N; mask++) {
            int count = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            lookup[mask] = masksWithCount.get(count).size();
            masksWithCount.get(count).add(mask);
        }

        Map<Long, ModInt, SafeHash> possibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
        possibleMasks.put((long) 1 << lookup[0], new ModInt(1));

        for (int left = 0; left < N; left++) {
            Map<Long, ModInt, SafeHash> newPossibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
            ModInt[] products = new ModInt[1 << N];
            Arrays.fill(products, new ModInt(1));

            for (int current = 0; current < 1 << N; current++)
                for (int right = 0; right < N; right++)
                    products[current] = products[current].times((current >> right & 1) ? probability[left][right] : new ModInt(1).minus(probability[left][right]));

            int[] newBits = new int[N];
            int[] newPossible = new int[1 << N];
            Arrays.fill(newPossible, 0);

            for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> entry : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
                long possible = entry.getKey();
                ModInt prob = entry.getValue();

                for (int mask : masksWithCount.get(left))
                    if ((possible >> lookup[mask] & 1) == 1)
                        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
                            if ((mask >> i & 1) == 0)
                                newBits[i] |= 1 << lookup[mask | 1 << i];

                newPossible[0] = 0;

                for (int current = 1; current < 1 << N; current++) {
                    newPossible[current] = newPossible[current & (current - 1)] | newBits[__builtin_ctz(current)];
                    newPossibleMasks.put((long) newPossible[current], newPossibleMasks.getOrDefault((long) newPossible[current], new ModInt(0)).plus(prob.times(products[current])));
                }
            }

            possibleMasks = newPossibleMasks;
            System.out.println(possibleMasks.size());
        }

        ModInt answer = new ModInt(0);

        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> entry : possibleMasks.entrySet())
            if ((entry.getKey() >> lookup[(1 << N) - 1] & 1) == 1)
                answer = answer.plus(entry.getValue());

        System.out.println(answer.val);
    }
}
